channel.title: Demo Property and SME Wire
channel.description: Fictional property, infrastructure and SME funding wire used by Funds.ae demo mode

item.title: Dubai developer Sandhaven launches AED 500m real estate fund for build-to-rent homes
item.description: The fund will buy completed apartment blocks in established Dubai communities and hold them for rental income.

item.title: Tidewell REIT raises AED 300m to buy logistics warehouses in Abu Dhabi
item.description: The listed real estate investment trust said demand from e-commerce tenants remains strong across the emirate's industrial zones.

item.title: Sharjah infrastructure fund backs new solar and water projects
item.description: The infrastructure investment programme will co-finance utility-scale solar plants and a desalination upgrade.

item.title: Emirati SME grant scheme opens AED 100m funding programme for manufacturers
item.description: Small manufacturers can apply for grants of up to AED 500,000 to modernise equipment and hire local staff.

item.title: Dubai SME fund offers soft loans to 200 early-stage food companies
item.description: The SME support programme pairs interest-free soft loans with mentoring from established regional food brands.

item.title: Abu Dhabi innovation fund awards startup grants to 40 climate-tech founders
item.description: Each founder receives a grant and access to pilot sites operated by local utilities.

item.title: Brindlecourt Infrastructure closes €1.2bn infrastructure fund for European data centres
item.description: The final close drew commitments from pension funds and insurers in Europe and Asia.

item.title: London property fund Wexmoor raises £400m for student housing
item.description: The real estate fund will target purpose-built student accommodation in university cities.
